headline: 3-O-硫酸の隣も切れる、腸内細菌のヘパリン酵素
subhead: X線結晶構造で切断後の二糖が活性部位に収まる様子を捉え、LC-MSとNMRの結果を裏づけた

summary.question: ヘパリン分析の酵素は3-O-硫酸をもつ糖の近くをほとんど切れず、この部分の標準品を作りにくかった。
summary.approach: B. eggerthii由来のヘパリンリアーゼI（BeHepI）が五糖フォンダパリヌクスをどう切るかを、LC-MS・NMR・結晶構造で調べた。
summary.result: BeHepIは3-O-硫酸グルコサミンの手前も含む2か所を切った。従来のPhHepIは1か所だけだった。
summary.learned: BeHepIは、3-O-硫酸をもつ標準品の調製に向くと著者は考えている。
summary.open: ブタ粘膜ヘパリンから3-O-硫酸二糖を直接得られるかは、まだ確かめられていない。

question.quote: Pedobacter heparinus heparin lyases are currently widely employed for characterization of heparin and its derivatives, but have limited activity near regions of 3-O-sulfation, hindering analyses of anticoagulation relevant sequences.

approach.quote: Here, using a panel of biophysical and structural techniques, we show that Bacteroides eggerthii lyase I liberates ΔUA-GlcNS3S6S disaccharides from the defined pentasaccharide, fondaparinux.

result.quote: consistent with cleavage at both A↓GA*↓IA-OMe to liberate A, GA* and IA-OMe respectively

learned.quote: Such activity likely renders BeHepI better suited to the preparation of standards containing 3-O-sulfation, which will aid analyses of biologically important heparin/HS sequences.

open.quote: Whilst we have not unequivocally ascertained here whether BeHepI by itself can liberate 3-O-sulfated disaccharides from PMH

highlights.text: フォンダパリヌクスと反応させた結晶には、切断産物の不飽和二糖（GA*）が−1、−2サブサイトに見えた。3-O-硫酸はTyr93とLys99に配位し、切断で生じた二重結合の周りの密度は平面に近かった。

evidence.quote: electron density for GA* within the BeHepI active site was highly planar across the C3–C4–C5 region, in line with β-eliminative formation of a π-bond

highlights.text: PhHepIの実験構造はなく、AlphaFold予測との比較では、BeHepIのループ2に8残基の伸長があり、活性部位を覆う陽性の蓋になっている。これが活性の差の一因かもしれないという推測にとどまる。

evidence.quote: Loop 2 of BeHepI also contains an eight amino acid extension compared to PhHepI, forming an elongated cationic lid that covers its active site.
These differences may rationalize (in part) the improved activity of BeHepI against more negatively charged heparin/HS oligosaccharides carrying 3-O-sulfation

highlights.text: NMRで切断を時間を追って測ると、AGA*↓IAの結合はA↓GA*IAよりずっと速く切れた。3-O-硫酸の隣も切れるが、ほかの部位が優先される。

evidence.quote: Quantitation of ΔUA 1H peaks over time revealed that the AGA*↓IA-OMe site was cleaved substantially more rapidly than A↓GA*IA-OMe

lab_notes.expression: 大腸菌C41(DE3) pLysSでpET-22b(+)から発現し、1 mM IPTGで誘導。
lab_notes.construct: N末端のリーダー配列を除いた残基21–394（WP_004294077.1）。
lab_notes.purification: HisTrap FF、サイズ排除（S75）、陽イオン交換（Resource S）の順。緩衝液に5 mM CaCl2を含む。
lab_notes.sample_prep: 2 M硫酸アンモニウム、0.1 M酢酸Na（pH 5.0）で結晶化。複合体はフォンダパリヌクスの粉末を結晶の滴に直接加え、5分後に回収。
lab_notes.data_collection: Diamond Light Sourceで収集。3IKWを探索モデルにMOLREPで位相を決め、REFMAC5で精密化。

evidence.quote: Transformed cells were grown to OD600 0.6–0.8, and induced with 1 mM IPTG.
lacking the N-terminal leader sequence (21–394), was inserted into pET-22b(+)
Initial protein capture was carried out by using a HisTrap FF column (Cytiva)
Further polishing was conducted by size-exclusion (Cytiva S75 16/600; 25 mM Tris, 100 mM NaCl, 5 mM CaCl2 pH 7.4 buffer) and ion-exchange
Well-diffracting crystals of BeHepI were grown and cryo-harvested from 2 M (NH4)2SO4, 0.1 M CH3CO2Na, pH 5.0.
Ligand complexes with fondaparinux were obtained by addition of ligand powder directly into drops containing crystals, followed by incubation for 5 minutes before harvesting.
Diffraction data was collected at Diamond Light Source (UK).
Structures were solved by molecular replacement with MOLREP (Vagin and Teplyakov 2010), using PDB 3IKW as a search model

editor_notes: 本文は apo を 1.7 Å、フォンダパリヌクス処理を 1.9 Å と書くが、PDB では 9GRW が 1.85 Å、9GV9 が 1.715 Å で逆になっている。数値は書かず PDB に任せた。3IKW（B. thetaiotaomicron の相同体）が既報。9GV9 は 3-O 硫酸二糖（GA*）が入った産物複合体。
legend_labels: ヘパリンリアーゼI（多糖分解酵素）
